name: Shortcut
summary: Shortcut tracks work as stories that move through customizable workflow states, with owners, a built-in Priority field and GitHub branch and pull request links. The Free plan allows 10 users, and the Team plan costs $8.50 per user per month on yearly billing.

facts.text: A new workspace starts with one workflow of four state types, Backlog, Unstarted, Started and Done, and states can be added, reordered and deleted.
Only the Free plan is limited to one workflow. Team and Business plans support several.
Priority is a predefined custom field with the default values P1 to P4, available on the Free, Team and Business plans.
People can be assigned as Owners on a story, and followers can be added to be notified of progress.
Event handlers in the GitHub integration move linked stories to a chosen workflow state on a branch, commit, pull request opening, approval or merge.
Team and Business plans use metered billing, which charges per user each month during the yearly billing cycle.
